workItem: Amend ADR-0104 so the current S1 activation slot is explicitly reset to AVAILABLE while preserving the historical PR #678 activation as non-authorizing evidence, retaining S2/S3 availability, single-chat/single-project PT8H binding, foreign-project routing and Human Owner-only Pull Request merge.
workItemDE: ADR-0104 so ändern, dass der aktuelle Aktivierungsslot S1 ausdrücklich auf AVAILABLE zurückgesetzt wird, während die historische Aktivierung aus PR #678 als nicht autorisierende Evidence erhalten bleibt; S2/S3 bleiben verfügbar, Single-Chat-/Single-Project-PT8H-Bindung, Foreign-Project-Routing und Human-Owner-only Pull-Request-Merge bleiben bestehen.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment. This branch does not itself activate S1. PR creation remains subject to the then-current exact-snapshot Human/Owner gate; merge remains Human Owner-only.
releaseReason: Human Merge of PR #689 satisfied the claim release condition. The claim is historical evidence only and must not remain an active writer.
